piece.headline: SUKRUT FIRES FIRST, NIHAR LEFT CHASING 9 POINTS
piece.standfirst: Sukrut opens with the week's best score and a Bench Boost that brought nothing. Nihar is the nearest chaser, 9 behind.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut leads from the first week, 9 clear of Nihar. The Bench Boost brought nothing from the bench, so he didn't even need it. It's early days, but everyone else now starts from behind.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Atharva Kshirsagar picked the wrong 11. 19 points stayed on the bench, the biggest swing of the week. The bench outscored the names he trusted.
piece.one_to_watch: The Gold spots line is tight: Atharva Singh and Anuj are split by 1 point. Captain picks next week could decide who takes the spot.

winners.name: Sukrut
winners.verdict: Top score of the week, 20 above average. The Bench Boost added nothing, so this was all starting XI. Skill, with a little swagger.

winners.name: Sudev
winners.verdict: Second best score of the week bar one, 10 above the average. Clean and quiet. Sudev keeps the pressure on without a chip.

winners.name: Atharva Singh
winners.verdict: 59 points, with 10 more left on the bench. Strong start, but a better pick of the XI would have put him closer to the top.

losers.name: Pradnyesh
losers.verdict: The week's lowest score. 17 points stayed on the bench. The selection calls will sting.

losers.name: Atharva Kshirsagar
losers.verdict: 19 points sat on the bench, the biggest pile in the league. Painful, but it's one week and the fix is simple.

losers.name: Sujal
losers.verdict: 35 points, 15 below average. A slow start, but nothing here a good week can't wipe away.
